claims.claim: Claude Code CLI auto-enables prompt caching on 4 prefix layers without user configuration
claims.citation: Claude Code CLI (CCh) wbudowal prompt caching jako fundament calej architektury, nie addon. Automatycznie cache'uje 4 warstwy prefiksu w kazdym requestcie - od statycznego system prompt po conversation history - bez zadnej konfiguracji uzytkownika.

claims.claim: Typical Claude Code session achieves 90-96% cache hit rate
claims.citation: Obserwowany cache hit rate dla typowej sesji to 90-96%, co sprawia ze long Opus session (100 turns) kosztuje $10-19 zamiast $50-100.

claims.claim: System prompt remains frozen and cacheable when dynamic data injected via <system-reminder> pattern
claims.citation: Dynamic data (daty, user email, git status) injectowane jako XML tagi w messages, NIE w system prompt. System prompt zostaje frozen i w pelni cacheable.

claims.claim: Default TTL is 5 minutes for free/pro plans; 1 hour for Max plan users
claims.citation: TTL domyslny: 5 minut (standard), 1 godzina (Max plan lub explicit ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H=1).

claims.claim: Anthropic silently changed default TTL from 1h to 5m for Max plan around March 6 2026
claims.citation: TTL regression marzec 2026: Anthropic silently zmienil default 1h -> 5m dla Max plan userow okolo 6 marca 2026 (potwierdzono 119,866 API calls na dwoch niezaleznych maszynach).

claims.claim: DISABLE_TELEMETRY env var disables 1h TTL tier as a side effect
claims.citation: DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 lub CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1 wylacza takze 1h TTL (fallback do 5m hardcoded default).

claims.claim: ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H env var was officially added in v2.1.108
claims.citation: Fix (v2.1.108): Dodano ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H=1 env var ktora explicite opt-in do 1h TTL niezaleznie od telemetrii.

claims.claim: /compact preserves system+tools+CLAUDE.md cache layers but invalidates conversation history
claims.citation: System + tools + CLAUDE.md layer: ZACHOWANE (jezeli TTL jeszcze nie wygasl). Conversation history: INVALIDATED. Stary prefix guaranteed stale.

claims.claim: /clear removes history while keeping system+tools+CLAUDE.md warm for 5 minutes
claims.citation: System + tools + CLAUDE.md layer: ZACHOWANE przez TTL okno (5m lub 1h). Conversation history: CLEARED.

claims.claim: /resume command has cache reuse bug in versions v2.1.69-v2.1.111
claims.citation: Observed bug (wiele wersji 2026): System prompt jest regenerowany, tool definitions re-assembled... Jezeli TTL wygas (>5min): pelny cache_write = 400-500k tokenow charged po raz drugi.

claims.claim: /rewind command causes full cache miss on entire conversation history
claims.citation: Szczegolnie destruktywny. Usuwa ostatnia wiadomosc z historii, ale... Wynik: pelny cache miss na calosci historii konwersacji.

claims.claim: Caching requires minimum token thresholds: 1024 for Sonnet/Haiku, 2048-4096 for Opus
claims.citation: Caching wymaga minimum: Sonnet / Haiku: 1,024 tokenow; Opus: 2,048-4,096 tokenow (zaleznie od wersji).

claims.claim: Cache hit rate formula: cache_read / (cache_read + cache_write + input) should exceed 0.90
claims.citation: Formula: cache_read / (cache_read + cache_write + input) >= 0.90. Rzeczywisty koszt po 100 turns (Opus): $10-19 vs $50-100 uncached.

claims.claim: Cache regression v2.1.69: --resume loses cache hit, charges 20x cost increase
claims.citation: Cache regression w --print --resume: cache_read frozen na ~14.5k (system prompt only), historia nie cache'owana. 20x cost increase.

claims.claim: Bun string replacement bug causes cache miss when history contains billing-related terms
claims.citation: Bun wykonuje string replacement na kazdym API request. Jezeli conversation history zawiera billing-related terms (np. 'rate limit', 'quota', 'subscription')... replacement breaks cache prefix.

claims.claim: Batch requests in single session cost 1.65x vs 6.25x for separate sessions
claims.citation: 5 pytan o ten sam codebase w jednej sesji = 1.65x koszt (vs 5 osobnych sesji = 6.25x).

claims.claim: --fork-session creates a fork sharing identical cache prefix with base session
claims.citation: --fork-session <session-id> tworzy fork ktory dzieli identyczny prefix z baza. Oba forki trafaja na ten sam cache klucz.

claims.claim: MCP tool definitions are deferred by default and only load full schema on use
claims.citation: MCP tool definitions sa domyslnie deferowane w nowszych CCh - tylko nazwy w kontekscie, full schema laduje sie przy uzyciu.

claims.claim: Adding MCP tool mid-session invalidates 15k+ tokens of tool definitions
claims.citation: Dodanie jednego tool mid-session inwaliduje 15,000+ tokenow tool definitions + caly prefix. Kosz jednej zmiany mid-session: pelny cache miss.

claims.claim: Recommended CLAUDE.md size limit is under 200 lines per Anthropic
claims.citation: Trzymaj CLAUDE.md < 200 linii (oficjalna rekomendacja Anthropic w CCh docs).

claims.claim: Model switching within session causes full cache rebuild for new model
claims.citation: Kazdy model ma oddzielny, izolowany cache. Przelaczenie Opus -> Sonnet w trakcie sesji = pelny rebuild dla nowego modelu.

claims.claim: Community-maintained cache fix (cnighswonger) identifies 3 independent cache regression mechanisms
claims.citation: Community-maintained fix identyfikuje 3 odrebne mechanizmy za cache regression: partial block scatter, fingerprint instability, non-deterministic tool ordering.

claims.claim: Cache regression versions v2.1.69-v2.1.111 have fingerprint instability bug
claims.citation: cc_version fingerprint pochodzi z messages[0] content. Gdy bloki sie relocate, fingerprint sie zmienia. API nie rozpoznaje requestu jako kontynuacji sesji -> pelny rebuild.

claims.claim: Tool definitions arrive in non-deterministic order, changing cache key between turns
claims.citation: Tool definitions przychodza w zmiennej kolejnosci miedzy turnami. Request bytes sie roznia -> inny cache klucz -> miss.

claims.claim: Active session with requests < 5min apart keeps cache warm indefinitely
claims.citation: Kazdy cache hit resetuje licznik TTL. Aktywna sesja z requestami co <5min utrzymuje cache indefinitely.

claims.claim: March 2026 TTL regression cost active users ~$949 total overpayment
claims.citation: Luty 2026 (1h period): overpaid $12.32 (1.1% waste). Marzec 2026 (po regresjii): overpaid $719.09 (25.9% waste). Lacznie kwi 2026: ~$949 strat dla jednego aktywnego uzytkownika.

claims.claim: Anthropic never officially explained the March 2026 1h->5m TTL regression
claims.citation: Issue zamkniete jako 'not planned'. Brak oficjalnej odpowiedzi od Anthropic.

claims.claim: Cache behavior with Agent Teams (new feature, CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1) is undocumented
claims.citation: Jak cache zachowuje sie z Agent Teams (nowa feature CCh 2026)? Kazdy agent ma swoj context window, ale czy dzielony cache prefiksu? Brak danych.

claims.claim: Workspace-level cache isolation (Feb 5 2026) impact on team CLAUDE.md sharing is unknown
claims.citation: Workspace-level cache isolation (od Feb 5, 2026, Anthropic) - jak to wplywa na team shared cache dla CLAUDE.md? Wszystkie istotne pytania bez odpowiedzi.

claims.claim: v2.1.88 or >= v2.1.112 are stable versions; intermediate versions have cache regressions
claims.citation: Rekomendacja wersji: freeze na v2.1.88 lub >=v2.1.112 (post-fix). Sprawdz changelog na kazdym update przed wdrozeniem.

gaps_flagged: Agent Teams cache behavior with CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 unknown - no documentation or community reports
Sub-agent cache inheritance: each spawned subagent has own system prompt, but does it inherit parent cache? No spec found
Exact /compact summary format and semantics undefined - what gets preserved, what discarded?
Workspace-level cache isolation (Feb 5 2026) impact on team CLAUDE.md cache sharing - documented as 'all users share' but isolation implications unclear
CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_GLOBAL_CACHE official status unknown - community discovery only, no official docs
conflicts_flagged: Cache hit rate in literature: '96%' (claudecodecamp.com) vs '90%' (dev.to) - likely measured in different conditions, conservative estimate 85-96%

Anthropic (The Register April 13 2026) claims quota drain 'not caused by cache tweaks' but community Issue #46829 has data showing 119,866 calls with real TTL change - both may be true (Anthropic refers to lack of intentional change, community shows real change occurred)
Piebald-AI documents __SYSTEM_PROMPT_DYNAMIC_BOUNDARY__ as internal marker - no official Anthropic documentation but high community trust (reverse-engineering on real binaries)
Official CCh docs do not list DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_HAIKU/SONNET/OPUS as options but community sources (dev.to, claudecodecamp.com) do - not confirmed in changelog
extractor_notes: R4 provides exceptional depth on cache mechanics, empirical cost data (119,866 API calls evidence), and detailed bug anatomy. High-confidence claims on env vars, TTL tiers, and /compact vs /clear semantics. Key gaps: Agent Teams, workspace isolation, sub-agent inheritance.
